long_biography.plain_text:
Richard James "Rick" Szelc works with private clients to design investment portfolios around their financial objectives. His advisory practice gives particular attention to the anxiety people feel when investing wealth they cannot readily replace. He has also served on Neuberger Berman's partnership committee.

A family research connection introduced Szelc to UT Southwestern: his brother-in-law Robert Kelly collaborated with geneticist Helen Hobbs. He served as a director of St. Paul Medical Foundation, which supports the medical centre, and helped organise its Transplant Tee fundraising golf tournament for the heart and lung transplant programmes.
